Aisha: Day 3 — quick question: who owns the "routing-fallback" behavior when Dedicated capacity is exhausted? Also who should I talk to about 'team edges' docs (which team owns overlaps like routing vs. model-variants vs. billing)?
Devon: infra owns the low-level capacity signals + autoscaling rules. Platform owns the policy layer that maps rules to model variants and regions. Billing only alerted for quota/commitary breaches. :wave:
Olivia: +1 to Devon. For ownership matrix we keep a lightweight doc in #eng-platform wiki: https://go.redwood/ops/team-edges (ping me if you can't access).
Aisha: thanks — and for escalation: if traffic hits Dedicated limit after hours, which rotation gets paged? I saw both infra and platform on call.
Tariq: SRE owns the primary pager for infra-level capacity (timeouts, node failures). But platform is secondary for policy mismatches. Our rota is in ops oncall — infra-primary, platform-secondary. If it's a model routing regression, platform triages first.
Aisha: got it. what's the short inc triage checklist to decide who to page? trying to avoid wake-the-wrong-person.
Devon: short checklist:
1) Are GPUs/instances at 100% or OOM? -> page infra
2) Are requests hitting fallback models unexpectedly? -> page platform
3) Is billing limit/commit hit? -> billing
4) Anything that looks like degraded logits/quality -> ping platform + applied-ml
You can paste that into a quick runbook.
Olivia: here's the snippet we ask folks to paste into incidents:
```
summary: "Dedicated capacity exhausted — fallback triggered"
observed: "fallback to smaller-quant model; increased latency"
initial-checks: "gpu_util, node_count, model_variant"
pager: "infra-primary / platform-secondary"
```
Aisha: perfect, thanks! one last thing — who maintains the 'edges' doc? I can open a PR to clean up after we triage a couple of cases.
Olivia: I own it but would love a PR. Tag me in the PR and in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Reminder: infra oncall this week is @devon, platform oncall is @olivia
Aisha: awesome, will draft a tiny PR and cc you both. thanks all! :heart:
